examples.text: Wrote voice.wav (review, sound only, 00:02.000 long) in 0.3s. Only Voice plays, at the timeline's own level (not mastered).
Wrote movie.mp4 (youtube1080: 1920x1080 H.264 at 20 Mbps, wide format, 00:02.000 long) in 1.5s. Loudness -16.0 LUFS, true peak -1.0 dBTP (mastered to -16 LUFS, peaks under -1 dBTP).

Speech is levelled to -20.0 LUFS; export brings the mix to -16.0 LUFS with true peaks under -1.0 dBTP.
  voice  voice.wav  -24.0 LUFS, peak -5.0 dBTP, range 2.0 LU
  offline  offline.wav  not measured yet
1 of 1 speech clips aren't at the speech level; normalizeSpeech sets them.
1 speech clip peaks over the -1.0 dBTP ceiling once levelled (up to +1.0 dBTP), which export's limiter squashes; normalizeSpeech holds them with a compressor and a limiter.
Clip levels by track (clip gain is added after levelling):
  A1 Voice  1 clip  levelled to -20.0 LUFS (+4.0 dB)  gain +2.0 dB

Voice and Music from 00:00.000 to 00:01.000, every 1 s, as the timeline plays it (export's master gain moves it all by the same amount).
Integrated -20.0 LUFS, true peak -3.0 dBTP. Loudest: -20.0 LUFS momentary at 00:01.000.
Short-term: ·▇
  time        momentary   short-term  peak
  00:00.000   silent      silent
  00:01.000   -20.0 LUFS  -20.0 LUFS  -3.0 dBFS
Momentary is the 400 ms centred on each time, short-term the 3 s, peak the highest sample in the 400 ms.
Gain lanes against the render, 00:00.000 to 00:01.000:
  No audio track plays here.

The mix from 00:00.000 to 00:01.000, every 1 s, as the timeline plays it (export's master gain moves it all by the same amount).
Integrated silent, true peak silent.
Short-term: 
1 window peaks over -3.0 dBFS, in 1 stretch:
  00:00.200-00:00.600  peak -2.0 dBFS (1 window)
A window is the 400 ms centred on a row; its peak is its highest sample.
Gain lanes against the render, 00:00.000 to 00:01.000:
  Voice  follows its lane (1 s compared, within 0.2 dB)
